entities.name: Graph RAG
entities.description: A retrieval-augmented generation approach using graphs, which outperformed naive RAG on comprehensiveness and diversity.

entities.name: naïve RAG
entities.description: A baseline retrieval-augmented generation method without graph structures, outperformed by Graph RAG conditions.

entities.name: TS
entities.description: Global text summarization without a graph index, used as a baseline condition.

entities.name: C0
entities.description: A Graph RAG condition using root-level community summaries, requiring significantly fewer tokens than other conditions.

entities.name: C1
entities.description: A Graph RAG condition using community summaries.

entities.name: C2
entities.description: A Graph RAG condition using community summaries.

entities.name: C3
entities.description: A Graph RAG condition using community summaries.

entities.name: Podcast Transcripts
entities.description: A dataset of podcast transcripts used for evaluation, with specific token counts and unit counts reported for various conditions.

entities.name: News Articles
entities.description: A dataset of news articles used for evaluation, with specific token counts and unit counts reported for various conditions.

entities.name: comprehensiveness
entities.description: A metric measuring the completeness of answers, where Graph RAG outperformed naive RAG.

entities.name: diversity
entities.description: A metric measuring the variety of answers, where Graph RAG outperformed naive RAG.

entities.name: Map-reduce summarization
entities.description: A resource-intensive approach for summarizing source texts, requiring the highest number of context tokens.

entities.name: community summaries
entities.description: A technique used in Graph RAG conditions C0-C3 to generate summaries from graph communities, generally improving answer comprehensiveness and diversity.
